method.authority: Candidate membership only. No duplicate, relevance, implementation, or cleanup verdict is inferred from a signal.
method.union: Frozen IDs with any original candidate reason, any shared-root/title-family membership, or any lineage exception.
method.noSignal: Not manually reviewed. Preserve pending full relevance review; absence of generated signals does not prove relevance or uniqueness.
method.protection: Retain original floors exactly. no-candidate-signal describes the old generator, not a hard preservation floor. Payload claim/gate/hub markers are retained for full-body inspection, never cleared.
method.liveBoundary: Frozen row values remain frozen. Lineage uses the previously recorded live snapshot; any mutation requires a new current-row check in P-004.
method.bulkRun: Not read or queried by this transformation. The earlier snapshot has no new verdict authority.
method.rule: No fleet, scheduler, work-item-state, or service writes.
